关键澄清：`D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin` 目录**存在**（是真实目录），但其 `.git` 链接文件缺失（`Get-Content` 报不存在），且 `vite.config.js`/`src/views/...` 等源文件也不在——这应是**主工作树子模块本就未初始化/损坏的前置状态**，非本次操作所致（我只动过任务 worktree 与其子模块，路径不同）。

此外 `git -C $main status` 显示主仓库根有 `bug6373-close.gif`、`tmp-gifframes/`、`tmp-imagediff.txt`、`.tmp-bug-6324.png`、改动的 `env/.env`、`docs/前端/`——这些是验证产物/其它改动，落在了主工作树（因会话 cwd 即主仓库）。这些不影响已推送的 develop 合并，但我需查清性质再决定是否清理（主工作树是硬约束，env/.env 与 docs/前端/ 未必是我的）。先只读核查：

tool_input.command:
$main = "D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3"
$mainSub = "$main\zhi2-web-admin"
Write-Host "=== main submodule worktree top-level contents ==="
Get-ChildItem "$mainSub" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Mode | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Host ("mainSub .git exists? " + (Test-Path "$mainSub\.git"))
Write-Host "=== parent repo: what changed in env/.env ==="
git -C $main diff --stat env/.env 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200
git -C $main diff env/.env 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 30 | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Host "=== docs/前端/ contents ==="
Get-ChildItem "$main\docs\前端" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Host "=== confirm temp artifacts at main repo root ==="
@("bug6373-close.gif";"tmp-gifframes";"tmp-imagediff.txt";".tmp-bug-6324.png") | ForEach-Object { "$_ : " + (Test-Path "$main\$_") }
Write-Host "=== who created bug6373-close.gif? (git ignore check) ==="
git -C $main check-ignore "bug6373-close.gif" 2>&1
git -C $main status --short 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 300
tool_input.description: Read-only investigation of main worktree artifacts and submodule state

parts.text:
核查结论（只读已确认）：

- **主子模块工作树** `D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3\zhi2-web-admin` 目录为空、`.git` 链接缺失 → 是**主工作树子模块本就未初始化/损坏的前置状态**，非本次操作造成（我只动过任务 worktree 与其子模块，路径完全不同；子模块 gitdir 含全部提交，可 `git submodule update` 恢复）。无数据丢失。
- `env/.env` 仅切换了本地代理注释行（用户本地开发配置），`docs/前端/bug6306-...md` 是 **#6306** 的文档，二者均**非本次任务**，留作不动。
- `bug6373-close.gif`、`tmp-gifframes/`、`tmp-imagediff.txt`、`.tmp-bug-6324.png` 是我本次 #6373 验证产生的临时产物，落在主工作树根（会话 cwd 即主仓库）。清理这些**明确属于我的临时文件**，不动用户的 env/.env 与 docs/前端/。

清理我的临时产物，并核对主工作树本地 develop 能否干净 FF 同步到 origin：

tool_input.command:
$main = "D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3"
$subMainGit = "D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3\.git\modules\zhi2-web-admin"
# Remove MY temp verification artifacts from main repo root (targeted, not a blanket clean)
@("bug6373-close.gif";"tmp-imagediff.txt";".tmp-bug-6324.png") | ForEach-Object {
  if (Test-Path "$main\$_") { Remove-Item "$main\$_" -Force; Write-Host ("removed file: $_") }
}
if (Test-Path "$main\tmp-gifframes") { Remove-Item "$main\tmp-gifframes" -Recurse -Force; Write-Host "removed dir: tmp-gifframes" }
Write-Host "=== main repo status after cleanup ==="
git -C $main status --short 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 300
Write-Host "=== FF-ability: main worktree develop -> origin/develop (parent) ==="
$parentLocal = git -C $main rev-parse develop/v3.0.0 2>&1
$parentFF = git -C $main merge-base --is-ancestor $parentLocal origin/develop/v3.0.0 2>$null; $pExit = $LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host ("parent local=$parentLocal ; FF to origin/develop: " + ($pExit -eq 0))
Write-Host "=== FF-ability: main submodule develop -> origin/develop (submodule) ==="
$subLocal = git --git-dir="$subMainGit" rev-parse develop/v3.0.0 2>&1
$subFF = git --git-dir="$subMainGit" merge-base --is-ancestor $subLocal origin/develop/v3.0.0 2>$null; $sExit = $LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host ("submodule local=$subLocal ; FF to origin/develop: " + ($sExit -eq 0))
tool_input.description: Clean own temp artifacts and check FF-ability
